title: Send to Terminal needs Invoicing & payments Create & Edit AND Customer portal ON
preconds:
1. Card terminal payments are set up for the organization with a terminal reader.
  2. An invoiced, unpaid work order with a contact exists.
  3. Two custom-role users: a Control user (Invoicing & payments Create & Edit AND Customer portal ON) and a Leak user (Invoicing & payments Create & Edit but Customer portal OFF).
